% SCI-MAP scientific contract v0.1, shared canonical authority.
% Document revision r0.1. This file is an included LaTeX source, not a
% stand-alone publication. Both published views import these exact clauses.

\providecommand{\SCIMapContractVersion}{v0.1}
\providecommand{\SCIMapDocumentRevision}{r0.1}
\providecommand{\SCIMapApprovalState}{Author draft for scientific-owner review}
\providecommand{\SCIMapApprovalDate}{2026-08-16}

% The including document supplies these renderers.
\providecommand{\SCIMapRequirement}[4]{}
\providecommand{\SCIMapPrediction}[4]{}

% Canonical equations. They are typeset in the scientist-facing view only.
\newcommand{\SCIMapObservationEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 a_{pi} &= G_{pi}\,\omega_i,
 \label{eq:effective-coefficient}\\
 \mathcal C_p&=\{i:\text{all declared contribution predicates pass and }a_{pi}>0\},
 \label{eq:contribution-set}\\
 \mathcal S_{\rm out}(\Pi_{\rm eff})
 &=\{p:\operatorname{authorize}_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}(p)=1\},
 \label{eq:support-authorized-row-set}\\
 N_p &= \sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p} a_{pi}x_i, &
 Q_p &= \sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p} a_{pi},
 \label{eq:ordinary-accumulators}\\
 K_p&=\sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p}a_{pi}k_i,
 \label{eq:response-accumulator}\\
 \widehat x_p &= N_p/Q_p, &
 \widehat k_p&=K_p/Q_p, \qquad p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:ordinary-products}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapOperatorEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 D_Q&=\operatorname{diag}(G\Omega\boldsymbol 1),
 &J_{\rm out}\boldsymbol z&=(z_p)_{p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out}},
 &D_{Q,{\rm out}}&=J_{\rm out}D_QJ_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T},
 \label{eq:output-row-selection}\\
 A_{\rm out}&=D_{Q,{\rm out}}^{-1}J_{\rm out}G\Omega,
 &\widehat{\boldsymbol x}_{\rm out}&=A_{\rm out}\boldsymbol y,
 \label{eq:map-operator}\\
 R_{\rm out}&=A_{\rm out}H,
 &\mathbb E[\widehat{\boldsymbol x}_{\rm out}\mid\Theta]
   &=R_{\rm out}\boldsymbol s+A_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\mu_0,
 &C_{x,{\rm out}}&=A_{\rm out} N A_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}.
 \label{eq:response-covariance}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapFormalWeightEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \operatorname{Var}(\widehat x_p\mid\Theta)
 &=\frac{\sum_iG_{pi}^{2}\omega_i}
         {(\sum_iG_{pi}\omega_i)^2},
 &
 \operatorname{Cov}(\widehat x_p,\widehat x_r\mid\Theta)
 &=\frac{\sum_iG_{pi}G_{ri}\omega_i}{Q_pQ_r},
 \qquad p,r\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:fractional-covariance}\\
 \phi_p&=\frac{Q_p^2}{\sum_iG_{pi}^{2}\omega_i},
 &
 \phi_p=Q_p&\Longleftrightarrow
 \sum_i\omega_i(G_{pi}^{2}-G_{pi})=0,
 \qquad p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:formal-weight}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapThresholdEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \mathcal I_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}&=\text{the declared support-policy population},
 \label{eq:threshold-population-identity}\\
 \mathcal P&=\{Q_p:\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                     p\in\mathcal I_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}\},
 &N&=|\mathcal P|,
 \label{eq:threshold-population}\\
 k&=\left\lfloor\frac{\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N}{2}\right\rfloor,
 &Q_\star&=\begin{cases}\mathcal P_{(k)},&N>0,\\0,&N=0,\end{cases}
 \label{eq:threshold-selector}\\
 c&=\texttt{coverage\_cut},
 &\operatorname{admit}_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}
   \bigl(c,\operatorname{unit\_status}(c)\bigr)&=1,
 \label{eq:coverage-cut-admission}\\
 T_{\rm norm}&=Q_\star c/10,
 &T_{\rm sci}&=Q_\star c,
 \label{eq:support-thresholds}\\
 S_p^{\rm norm}&=\boldsymbol 1[\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                                  Q_p\ge T_{\rm norm}],
 \label{eq:normalization-support}\\
 S_p^{\rm sci}&=\boldsymbol 1[\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                                 Q_p\ge T_{\rm sci}].
 \label{eq:support-predicates}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapCoaddEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \mathcal S^c_{\rm out}
 &=\{p:\operatorname{authorize}_{\Pi^c_{\rm eff}}(p)=1\},
 \label{eq:coadd-support-authorized-row-set}\\
 N^c_p&=\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op}\widehat x_{op},
 &Q^c_p&=\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op},
 \label{eq:coadd-accumulators}\\
 \widehat s_p&=N^c_p/Q^c_p, \qquad p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:coadd-ordinary}\\
 J^c_{\rm out}\boldsymbol z&=(z_p)_{p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}},
 \label{eq:coadd-output-row-selection}\\
 \widehat{\boldsymbol s}_{\rm out}
   &=(\widehat s_p)_{p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}}
     =B_{\rm out}\widehat{\boldsymbol x}_{\rm obs},
 \label{eq:coadd-map-operator}\\
 \widehat k^c_p&=\frac{\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op}\widehat k_{op}}{Q^c_p},
 \qquad p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}.
 \label{eq:coadd-response-product}\\
 C_{c,{\rm out}}&=B_{\rm out} C_{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T},
 &R_{c,{\rm out}}&=B_{\rm out}T.
 \label{eq:coadd-companions}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapRequirements}{%
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-001}{Versioned authority}{The scientific contract version shall be \SCIMapContractVersion. The rendered document revision shall be recorded separately as \SCIMapDocumentRevision; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented as a new scientific contract version.}{Inspect both artifacts and their machine-readable provenance for distinct contract-version and document-revision fields.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-002}{Capability and calibrated input}{The ordinary input shall be calibrated SCI-CAL ordinary-\texttt{xs} Stokes-I samples with exact sample-by-detector membership and active signal unit \texttt{mJy/beam}. No other stream, Stokes component, or accepted unit token shall inherit this authority.}{Exercise accepted and rejected stream, Stokes, and unit identities; require fail-closed behavior for every unauthorized alternative.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-003}{Explicit identity}{Every candidate contribution shall carry explicit observation, array, network when applicable, map-group, Stokes, input-column, and occurrence/product-scoped detector-acquisition identity. Container position, row equality, or a local key alone shall not establish scientific identity.}{Permute containers and rows while preserving or breaking explicit bindings; scientific products shall follow the binding and reject ambiguity.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-004}{Upstream eligibility}{SCI-MAP shall consume, without redefining, the upstream sample/detector eligibility, flag precedence, calibration-validity, and non-finite states supplied by VAL and SCI-CAL.}{Toggle each upstream state independently and demonstrate that the mapmaker neither promotes nor silently recodes it.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-005}{Projection authority}{Each contribution shall use an externally supplied finite sample-to-map relation in a declared frame, WCS, pixel basis, extent, and boundary convention. SCI-MAP shall not choose pointing, interpolate a missing coordinate, wrap, clamp, or invent an out-of-grid placement.}{Use centers, subpixel coordinates, boundaries, non-finite coordinates, and out-of-grid coordinates with an independently calculated mapping.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-006}{Ordinary coefficient status}{Each admitted ordinary analysis coefficient shall be finite and strictly positive, with declared unit, normalization scope, lifecycle, applied factors, and statistical status. Zero is noncontributing; negative and non-finite ordinary coefficients are invalid.}{Inject positive, zero, negative, and non-finite coefficients and inspect contributions, diagnostics, and labels.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-007}{Exposure meaning}{Every exposure contribution shall be finite and nonnegative in a named unit and accounting convention. Detector-seconds shall not be labeled wall-clock integration time without an explicit multiplicity normalization.}{Use a fixture with unequal detector multiplicity and sample durations; compare both exposure facts to hand sums and inspect units.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-008}{Response input state}{The response input shall be either a sample-domain kernel/template tracer with source, normalization, unit, processing-parent identity, and membership, or an explicit typed unavailable state. A numerical sentinel shall not represent unavailability.}{Exercise complete and unavailable response states and verify exact metadata, no fabricated array, and consumer fail-closed routing.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-009}{Immutable plan and lifecycle}{The accepted request shall be immutable and shall resolve one way through requested, effective, observation-resolved, and realized states. Disabled expert values remain inactive; one observation's resolved state shall not leak into another.}{Compare serialized states across two deliberately different observations and verify one-way provenance and complete replacement.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-010}{Contribution predicate}{For each pixel, the estimator contribution set shall be fixed by declared eligibility, finite signal, finite positive effective coefficient, admitted projection and boundary, and every required companion predicate before any payload is accumulated.}{Vary one predicate at a time and compare the exact admitted set against an independent oracle.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-011}{Ordinary accumulators}{On the fixed contribution set, SCI-MAP shall accumulate the pre-normalized signal numerator \(N_p=\sum_i a_{pi}x_i\), normalization \(Q_p=\sum_i a_{pi}\), and, when available, response numerator \(K_p=\sum_i a_{pi}k_i\), where \(a_{pi}=G_{pi}\omega_i>0\).}{Use one-pixel, one-hot, and fractional hand calculations; compare accumulators before normalization.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-012}{Normalized publication}{The scientific normalized output vector shall contain exactly the rows \(p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out}\) authorized by the applicable effective support policy. On those rows a finite \(Q_p>0\) gives \(\widehat x_p=N_p/Q_p\) and an available response companion gives \(\widehat k_p=K_p/Q_p\). Accumulators or storage slots may exist elsewhere, but no unsupported row, zero-filled value, or sentinel is a normalized scientific output or measured zero sky.}{Exercise positive, exact-zero, near-zero finite, overflowed, and non-finite aggregates; compare the exact output-row set and its cardinality with an independent support oracle, and inspect any retained storage slot together with validity.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-013}{Accumulator interpretation}{The numerator is a pre-normalized accumulator and \(Q_p\) is a normalization fact by default. Neither shall be labeled a sky estimator, inverse variance, confidence, coverage, or significance without the separately required conditions.}{Audit schema, metadata, API types, and labels for every numerator and normalization representation.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-014}{Constant preservation}{With fixed admitted membership and positive coefficients, the ordinary estimator shall preserve a constant admitted sample input on every row in its exact support-authorized output set. This prediction shall not create rows outside that set or be promoted to compact-source, extended-source, integrated-flux, absolute-offset, or astrometric fidelity.}{Map constant fixtures with uniform and unequal coefficients; compare exact output-row membership, then confirm that stronger response claims remain separately gated.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-015}{Projection-specific estimand}{One-hot assignment and fractional projection shall be identified explicitly. For fractional projection, normalized gridding shall not be mislabeled diagonal weighted least squares, and \(Q_p\) shall not be promoted to formal precision by analogy.}{Use a split-sample counterexample and compare normalized gridding, diagonal-WLS normalization, variance, and cross-pixel covariance.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-016}{Same operator for linear companions}{Signal, available response/kernel tracer, and declared linear realizations shall use the same admitted membership, geometric placement, and exact support-authorized output-row selection; retained exposure and coadd observation count shall use the same membership and placement wherever their definitions require them.}{Trace coefficient-by-coefficient membership, placement, and scientific output-row selection through signal and each declared linear companion.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-017}{Realized response claim}{A stored kernel may be called the realized response to template \(\boldsymbol\tau\) only when its sample parent satisfies \(\boldsymbol k=H\boldsymbol\tau\) and the support-restricted map product satisfies \(\widehat{\boldsymbol k}_{\rm out}=A_{\rm out}H\boldsymbol\tau=R_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\tau\) on exactly the authorized rows. Otherwise it shall be labeled only a tracer or unavailable.}{Inject a declared template and an intentionally mismatched tracer; compare exact response-row membership and accept the response label only for the proven identity.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-018}{Absolute-offset mode}{SCI-MAP v0.1 shall apply no signal-centering operation: \(L=I\). Coaddition shall not subtract a mean, remove a constant mode, or recenter a source; any upstream loss of that mode shall remain explicit in response and provenance.}{Use a constant-offset fixture and inspect both the mapped value and recorded upstream response/null-mode state.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-019}{Conditional covariance}{For fixed complete state \(\Theta\), the authoritative ordinary noise covariance on the exact support-authorized row set shall be \(C_{x,{\rm out}}=A_{\rm out} N A_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\), retaining consequential cross-pixel terms among those rows. It is conditional on selected calibration, pointing, eligibility, coefficients, response, geometry, and support policy; no zero-filled extension is scientific covariance.}{For a small explicit matrix, compare the exact covariance row/column identity and values with direct row-selected matrix multiplication.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-020}{When normalization is precision}{The normalization may be called marginal inverse variance only when coefficients are calibrated true inverse variances, selected sample errors are independent for the asserted domain, and the projection satisfies \(\sum_i\omega_i(G_{pi}^2-G_{pi})=0\); one-hot assignment is the standard sufficient case.}{Test the authorized one-hot specialization and at least one fractional or correlated counterexample.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-021}{Formal diagonal weight}{When its assumptions hold on an authorized output row, the formal marginal inverse variance shall be \(\phi_p=Q_p^2/\sum_iG_{pi}^2\omega_i\). It shall remain distinct from \(Q_p\), from the support-restricted full precision matrix \(C_{x,{\rm out}}^+\), and from empirical statistical weight.}{Compute all four objects for a fractional fixture and verify exact row identity, distinct identities, and metadata.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-022}{Covariance and nuisance state}{The bundle shall declare whether full covariance is persisted, lineage-resolvable, summarized, or unavailable; it shall list omitted correlations and the status of calibration, astrometric, response, and additive-bias nuisance terms. Unavailable information shall not be silently set to zero.}{Inspect each allowed representation state and require stronger consumers to reject insufficient covariance or nuisance information.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-023}{Data-derived state}{If membership, coefficients, response, or geometry are estimated or selected from the same data, the displayed linear expectation and covariance shall remain explicitly conditional; unconditional bias or covariance requires a named joint model or resampling result outside this fixed-state claim.}{Use metadata cases for fixed and data-derived state and verify that unconditional labels appear only with separately admitted evidence.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-024}{No significance promotion}{Signal multiplied by the square root of merely formal weight shall be labeled formal standardized signal, not \texttt{sig2noise} or empirical significance. Empirical calibration remains NOI-owned.}{Attempt each prohibited relabeling through all public representations and require rejection or an unmistakable non-significance label.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-025}{Eight distinct facts}{Every raw bundle shall separately represent geometric projected incidences, estimator-admitted contributions, admitted observation count for coadds, upstream-eligible exposure, retained exposure, numerical normalization support, science-policy support, and authoritative final raw science validity. No alias shall become authority for another fact.}{Construct cases in which each pair differs and verify eight separately typed identities.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-026}{Geometric incidences}{Geometric projected incidences shall count upstream-eligible entries whose declared projection touches a pixel, using an explicit fractional-projection counting convention, regardless of whether a positive ordinary coefficient is later admitted.}{Use zero-weight and fractionally split samples; compare the integer count with the declared touch convention.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-027}{Estimator contributions}{Estimator-admitted contributions shall count exactly the entries in the ordinary contribution set and shall exclude zero, negative, non-finite, flagged, and out-of-bounds candidates.}{Compare exact integer counts to an independently enumerated contribution set.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-028}{Admitted observation count}{For coadds, admitted observation count shall count complete observation bundles contributing at the pixel and shall not be confused with sample hits or observation attempts.}{Use one complete, one unsupported, and one rejected observation bundle and verify the per-pixel count.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-029}{Upstream-eligible exposure}{Upstream-eligible exposure shall sum the named exposure measure over the externally eligible projected population, before estimator-specific coefficient rejection, according to its declared exposure projection.}{Use eligible zero-weight entries and verify that upstream-eligible exposure changes without changing estimator contribution count.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-030}{Retained exposure}{Retained exposure shall sum the same named exposure measure over estimator-admitted membership and placement; it shall not be labeled precision.}{Use mixed eligible/admitted membership and compare retained exposure with hand sums and the normalization plane.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-031}{Adopted threshold selector}{For each declared support-policy population, sort its finite strictly positive normalization coefficients \(Q_p\); for count \(N>0\), select zero-based \(k=\lfloor(\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N)/2\rfloor\) and \(Q_\star=Q_{(k)}\); for empty input set \(Q_\star=0\). The exact population identity, exact \(c=\texttt{coverage\_cut}\), and its unit or dimensionless status shall be recorded. The effective support policy shall explicitly admit that exact \(c\) state before support resolution; otherwise the required product shall fail closed.}{Check empty and multiple population sizes against an independent integer-index oracle; inspect population identity and exact \(c\) admission. Exercise negative, zero, non-finite, and greater-than-one \(c\) states without assuming their disposition; only an explicitly owner-authorized effective-policy state may proceed.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-032}{Separate support predicates}{Only after the effective support policy explicitly admits the exact value and unit status of \(c\), numerical normalization support shall require an explicit finite positive \(Q_p\ge Q_\star c/10\), and science-policy support shall independently require an explicit finite positive \(Q_p\ge Q_\star c\). This contract asserts no general numeric domain or units for \(c\). Every non-authorized state fails closed before a support row set is constructed. Neither support state shall establish final validity or precision.}{Exercise values below, at, and above both thresholds, including \(N=0\), and compare exact Boolean planes and output-row sets; verify fail-closed behavior for every \(c\) state not explicitly admitted by the effective policy.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-033}{Authoritative raw validity}{One raw science-validity state shall require membership in the exact support-authorized output-row set, admitted bundle identity, both applicable support predicates, finite normalized signal, finite required companions, and absence of a product-level failure. A retained slot, finite payload, positive coefficient, exposure, hit count, support plane, or compatibility alias alone shall not make a pixel valid.}{Use a truth-table fixture that withholds each conjunct separately; compare exact output-row membership and attempt all prohibited promotions.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-034}{Screen before arithmetic}{Invalid contributions shall be excluded before their numerical payload is evaluated. Multiplication by zero, masking after accumulation, or sanitizing a non-finite aggregate shall not substitute for admission.}{Place NaN and Inf payloads behind false and true predicates and check contamination, diagnostics, and failure scope.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-035}{Exceptional contribution states}{Zero coefficient shall be noncontributing, a low positive coefficient shall follow the explicit adopted policy, negative or non-finite ordinary coefficients shall be invalid, and an out-of-bounds projection shall contribute nowhere. Each cause shall remain distinguishable.}{Run one-cause-at-a-time fixtures and inspect cause-specific states plus unchanged neighboring pixels.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-036}{Complete observation bundle}{An observation map shall be one immutable ordered bundle containing signal, numerator, normalization identity, response state, conditional uncertainty state, all eight facts where applicable, units, frame/WCS, shape/indexing, estimator, lifecycle, parentage, and exact product identity.}{Remove or alter each field in turn; complete-bundle construction and downstream admission shall fail closed.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-037}{Atomic coadd admission}{A complete observation bundle shall pass all compatibility and required-companion checks before any coadd-owned state changes. Rejection shall leave numerators, normalizations, counts, exposure, response, validity, provenance, and product cardinality unchanged.}{Snapshot all coadd-owned state before injecting one incompatibility at a time and require byte- or field-exact nonmutation.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-038}{Centered integer common grid}{Observation and coadd shapes shall differ by nonnegative even row and column counts, with the corresponding integer offset mapping their reference pixels to the same world coordinate. Fractional shift, reprojection, interpolation, wrapping, implicit recentering, and a different sky grid are forbidden.}{Test every parity/sign case and WCS reference-pixel relation with an independent coordinate oracle.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-039}{Ordinary coadd estimator}{For atomically admitted bundles and finite positive observation coefficients \(u_{op}\), the coadd shall accumulate \(N^c_p=\sum_o u_{op}\widehat x_{op}\) and \(Q^c_p=\sum_o u_{op}\), then publish \(\widehat s_p=N^c_p/Q^c_p\) only for rows in the exact effective coadd support set \(\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}\). No unsupported coadd row or zero-filled substitute is a scientific output.}{Use one observation and unequal positive coefficients; compare accumulators and the exact coadd output-row set with hand calculations and an independent support oracle.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-040}{Coadd companions}{Available response/kernel shall use the same atomic admission, centered-integer placement, and exact support-authorized output-row selection as coadd signal. Retained exposure and admitted observation count shall use the same admission and placement; the count increments once per admitted complete bundle at each applicable pixel.}{Use variable observation and coadd support plus offsets; compare signal/response row membership, companion placement, and exact count.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-041}{Coadd covariance and precision}{For fixed admission and support-restricted coadd operator \(B_{\rm out}\), conditional covariance shall be \(C_{c,{\rm out}}=B_{\rm out} C_{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\), including consequential cross-observation blocks among authorized rows. Summed observation coefficients equal coadd precision only for independent unbiased maps of the same unit-gain estimand weighted by their true marginal inverse variances.}{Use independent and correlated two-observation covariance fixtures and compare exact row-selected propagation with any precision label.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-042}{Correlated-GLS boundary}{A correlated minimum-variance solution using \(K_p^{-1}\boldsymbol 1\) may require negative combination coefficients and therefore belongs to a separately authorized correlated-GLS branch, not the ordinary positive-coefficient coadd.}{Use positive- and negative-correlation covariance matrices that distinguish ordinary weighting from the GLS benchmark; require method identity to remain explicit.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-043}{Minimum product identity}{Every observation and coadd product shall identify role, external observation or coadd identity, array and group, network/detector occurrence when applicable, Stokes I, estimator, response state/version, signal unit, frame, WCS, pixel shape/order, boundary policy, parentage, and product identity.}{Round-trip identity through every required representation and detect ambiguity after deliberate field collisions.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-044}{Frames and units}{Science products shall use their declared equatorial J2000 TAN WCS with degree-valued spatial axes; Pointing/OOF registered uses, if approved, shall use a declared AltAz tangent plane in arcseconds. Signal and a unit-bearing realized response carry \texttt{mJy/beam}; covariance carries its square and a conditionally valid formal weight its inverse square.}{Inspect coordinate and unit metadata and test that cross-frame or cross-unit coadd admission fails.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-045}{WCS and index persistence}{Full-precision typed or sidecar WCS shall be the lossless admission and provenance authority. A physical FITS WCS may differ by at most 0.1 arcsec maximum sky separation while preserving exact axis sign, handedness, orientation, and centered-integer shape/reference-pixel relations. FITS coordinates are one-based and memory indices zero-based.}{Round-trip representative centers, corners, axis signs, and index conversions; calculate maximum sky separation and exact orientation invariants.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-046}{Realized provenance}{Realized state shall record executed observations and groups, admitted contributions and bundles, accumulators, exact observation and coadd support-authorized output-row sets, all eight facts, response and covariance representation states, centered-integer offsets, completed required products, failures, and the exact requested/effective/resolved parents.}{Reconstruct each row-selected applied operator and its cardinality from provenance alone for a multi-observation fixture.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-047}{Failure scope and atomicity}{An invalid required input, incompatible bundle, unrepresentable finite aggregate, unrepresentable coordinate/index conversion, missing required companion, or failed required publication shall propagate at its declared contribution, pixel, observation-admission, or complete-product scope and shall fail before live aggregate state changes.}{Inject each failure class at its boundary; inspect exact scope, diagnostics, nonmutation, and absence of a false completion marker.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-048}{Required observation products}{A complete observation bundle remains required when coaddition is enabled, and every product designated required by the effective v0.1 plan shall be published successfully before completion is asserted. Whether future abstract contracts require physical observation-map publication independent of an effective product policy remains an owner decision.}{Induce an observation-product publication failure during coadd operation and require overall failure with no misleading completion claim.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-049}{Immutable raw parent}{Downstream transformations shall preserve resolvable raw bundle identity and the authoritative raw validity state. They shall not rewrite raw validity or promote a raw-invalid pixel through a filtered or consumer-local validity alias.}{Create a downstream-local valid result over a raw-invalid parent and verify that both states remain distinct and the raw state immutable.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-050}{Complete consumer boundary}{No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as a scientifically complete map. The boundary shall include estimator/normalization identity, response state, conditional uncertainty state and assumptions, eight facts, additive-bias/null-mode state, units, frame/WCS, shape/indexing, grouping, lifecycle, parentage, dependency versions, and failures; each consumer shall fail closed for missing facts needed by its claim.}{Exercise NOI, FLT, SRC, MODE, BEAM, and FRUIT admission profiles with one required fact missing at a time.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-051}{Same fixed noise operator}{An admitted noise realization may be described as using the same map/coadd operator only when eligibility, projection, grouping, coefficients, normalization, exact support-authorized row selection, boundary, and atomic coadd admission are fixed or identically prescribed. Re-estimation from the randomized data defines a different named estimator.}{Propagate fixed deterministic vectors through signal and realization paths and compare row identities and operator coefficients, not filenames or shapes.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-052}{Method and claim separation}{This authority shall not be applied by analogy to JINC, maximum-likelihood mapmaking, OOF residual transfer, reprojection, filtering, empirical noise, fitting, Beammap inference, feedback, Stokes Q/U, measured-R mapmaking, or other units. Algebraic contract correctness, engineering conformance, representation/response fidelity, observational performance, and production readiness shall remain separate claims.}{Attempt each method/claim promotion and verify explicit package/method rejection plus independent claim-state fields.}\par
}

\newcommand{\SCIMapPredictions}{%
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-001}{Uniform constant}{For fixed membership, a constant admitted input with uniform positive coefficients produces that constant on every support-authorized raw-valid output row; numerator and normalization scale together, and no unsupported scientific row is created.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-002}{Unequally weighted constant}{For fixed membership, unequal positive coefficients still preserve the same constant on every support-authorized output row, while normalization and conditional variance generally change with position; rows outside that set have no normalized scientific value.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-003}{One-pixel hand calculation}{For an authorized output row with admitted values \(x_i\) and coefficients \(a_i>0\), the exact expected triplet is \((N,Q,\widehat x)=(\sum a_ix_i,\sum a_i,\sum a_ix_i/\sum a_i)\); for an unauthorized row only declared accumulators or storage state may remain, never a normalized scientific zero.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-004}{Fractional split}{One sample split with \(G_{p1}=G_{r1}=1/2\) contributes to both pixels, creates cross-pixel covariance, and distinguishes normalized gridding from diagonal WLS. Two equal independent split samples give \(Q=1\), variance \(1/2\), and \(\phi=2\) per affected pixel.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-005}{Delta input}{A basis-pixel sky input produces the corresponding support-row-restricted column of \(R_{\rm out}=A_{\rm out}H\), including projection and boundary truncation; it need not be a delta in the output map, and no value is predicted outside the authorized rows.}{Representation fidelity}\par
